title: CLO 2026 Login Error 400 After Successful CLO-SET Login
content:
I am trying to log into CLO 2026 on a new Windows computer, but I consistently receive **Error Code 400** when signing in with CLO-SET.

My account information is correct, and the same account has worked on another computer.

What happens:

  * I select **“Sign in with CLO-SET”** in CLO 2026.

  * Chrome opens normally.

  * I sign into CLO-SET with the correct account.

  * Chrome takes me to the CLO website/homepage.

  * CLO 2026 then displays **Error Code 400** instead of recognizing the login.




I have already tried:

  * Allowing CLO through Windows Defender Firewall.

  * Creating inbound and outbound firewall rules for the CLO Standalone Online Authenticator.

  * Clearing Chrome cache and cookies.

  * Confirming Chrome allows site handlers.

  * Running CLO as administrator.

  * Restarting the computer.

  * Uninstalling and reinstalling the CLO authentication component.




The issue still occurs.

Could you please advise me on how to resolve Error Code 400? I suspect there may be an issue with the **CLO-SET-to-CLO application authentication/handoff**.

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Hi there, I saw that you submitted a ticket and also posted on the Discord. Our team replied to your ticket today, so please check your email and continue the conversation with them there!
content_description: This page seeks troubleshooting advice to resolve Error Code 400 occurring during CLO-SET authentication in CLO 2026 on a new Windows computer.

title: Looking for Advice from CLO 3D Professionals
content:
![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202608/29c66f3fdaef4977b514a88e636a26ff/images/bfe3946e227c4988992dffd7cbd10465switshirt.png)Hi everyone! 👋

I’m currently learning CLO 3D and would love to hear from people who are already working professionally with it.

I have experience designing and sewing clothes myself, and now I’m developing my skills in 3D garment visualization and pattern development in CLO 3D.

I’m curious — **how did you start your professional journey with CLO 3D?**

Where do you usually find clients or companies looking for CLO 3D designers, pattern makers, or apparel product developers? Are there any platforms, communities, or other places you would recommend?

I’m especially interested in eventually working with **American fashion brands and apparel companies** , so I’d really appreciate any advice from people who have experience working with US clients.

If you’re a professional CLO 3D designer, I’d love to hear about your journey — what worked for you when you were starting out, and what would you do differently today?

Thanks in advance! 🙏  
I’m looking forward to learning from the community and meeting other people in the industry.
content_description: A community-driven page for aspiring CLO 3D designers to connect, share experiences, and seek advice on building a professional career in 3D garment visualization and working with American fashion brands.
